folder.description: Only pages under this brain/ folder, for example people or projects/odin.

rerank.description: auto reranks 16 candidates; deep reranks 32 (slower, about 0.9 s); off skips it.

include_reference.description: true (default): also return up to 3 `reference` hits from the parsed reference text (papers, manuals, library), each with its local file path.
